title.narrative: The social innovation programme - UPSHIFT, to develop life skills and innovation skills, was scaled up to 6 regions in 2023, through youth centers, non-formal education and summer camps. Participation of young people in UNICEF programmes was strengthened by building capacities of young people in the Participatory Committee for Adolescents and Young people, including the Particpatory Action Research to support evidence-based advocacy.
